title: Recorded website conversation
description: One row of the conversation ledger (docs/design/provider-turns.md#conversation-ledger): a website conversation system created, recorded when it was bound, kept after its turns and receipts expire, and deleted on its site when its session is released.

sessionId.description: The session that owns it; absent for a temporary chat.

state.description: live: its session holds it; due: released, to be deleted; deleted: gone from the site; kept: never deleted (why in reason); failed: every attempt failed (in health).

reason.description: Why it is kept, or what the last failed deletion said.

decision.description: The retention decision that released it.
